metadata.title: WeightPilot
metadata.description: Private, personalised weight-management information and evidence-informed guidance.

home.eyebrow: Guidance that sees the whole person
home.title: A calmer, clearer path to managing your weight.
home.intro: WeightPilot brings evidence-informed information, a personalised assessment and practical next steps together in one private, reassuring place.
home.trust: Private by design · Evidence-informed · Built around you
home.photoAlt: Two adults having a supportive conversation in a bright, comfortable room.
home.photoCaption: Personalised guidance is most useful when your goals, health and everyday life are considered together.
home.supportBody: A considered experience that keeps information clear and your next steps easy to find.
home.approachBody: Weight-management guidance should feel personal, understandable and practical. WeightPilot is designed to make each step easier to navigate.
home.step1Body: Share your goals and health context through a structured questionnaire.
home.step2Body: Receive a clear, personalised guidance report with practical information about possible next steps.
home.step3Body: Keep your assessment, guidance report and private messages organised in one place.
home.optionsIntro: Healthy, lasting change rarely comes from one action alone. Knowing the main approaches can make the next conversation feel clearer.
home.option1Body: Weight can change when the energy your body uses and the energy you take in are out of balance. Food, activity and sustainable habits matter, while sleep, medicines, health conditions and biology can also influence progress.
home.option2Body: Support may include nutrition, physical activity and behaviour change. For some adults, prescribed medicines or specialist surgery may also be considered alongside ongoing lifestyle support and clinical review.
home.option3Body: The right approach depends on your health, medicines, goals, preferences and personal circumstances. A qualified clinician can help weigh the potential benefits, limitations and risks.
home.optionsNote: General information only — it does not replace personalised medical advice.
home.optionsCtaTitle: A more personal place to begin
home.optionsCtaBody: Explore guidance that considers your goals, health and everyday circumstances.
home.finalTitle: Ready to take the next step?
home.finalBody: Explore your options with guidance tailored to your circumstances.
home.finalInvitation: Personalised assessments and guidance reports are available by invitation.

footer.tagline: Thoughtful guidance for informed next steps.

auth.title: Welcome to WeightPilot
auth.description: Secure access to your personalised information and guidance.
auth.secureTitle: Your information, kept in one secure place.
auth.secureBody: Access your assessment, guidance report and private messages with an account protected by email verification and secure sessions.
auth.secureNote: WeightPilot is an information and guidance platform. It does not provide medical care or emergency support.
auth.signInDescription: Sign in to continue to your private WeightPilot account.
auth.registrationDescription: Enter your invitation and account details. We’ll ask you to verify your email before private access is enabled.
auth.registrationValidation: Check your invitation, name, email and password, then try again.
auth.registrationError: We couldn’t complete registration with those details. The invitation may be invalid, expired or already used.
auth.registrationCompleteBody: Your account has been created. Verify your email before signing in to private WeightPilot services.
auth.reactivationDescription: Use a new invitation with your existing email and password to restore your original account.
auth.reactivationValidation: Enter a valid invitation, email address and existing password.
auth.reactivationError: We couldn’t reactivate an account with those details. Check them and try again.
auth.reactivationCompleteBody: Your original information and history have been preserved. You can now sign in.
auth.invitationRateLimited: Too many attempts. Please wait before trying again.
auth.recoveryDescription: Enter your email and we will send password reset instructions if an account is associated with it.
auth.resetRequestSuccess: If an account is associated with that email, password reset instructions are on their way.
auth.resetDescription: Create a strong new password for your WeightPilot account.
auth.passwordHint: Use at least 12 characters. A unique passphrase is easier to remember and harder to guess.
auth.resetComplete: Your password has been updated. All previous sessions have been signed out.
auth.verificationPageDescription: Review the status of your secure verification link.
auth.verificationPendingDescription: A verified email is required before private WeightPilot services can be accessed. Enter your account email to request a new link.
auth.verificationSent: If the account is eligible, a new verification link is on its way.
auth.verificationCompleteDescription: Your email address is confirmed. You can now sign in securely.
auth.verificationProblemTitle: This verification link is not available
auth.verificationProblemDescription: The link may have expired or already been used. Request a new one to continue.
auth.accessDescription: Your account security settings determine access to this area.
auth.inactiveDescription: Private services are unavailable for this account. Use a new invitation and your existing credentials to reactivate it.
auth.unverifiedDescription: Confirm your email address before accessing private WeightPilot services.
auth.forbiddenTitle: You do not have access to this area
auth.forbiddenDescription: Your account does not have permission to open this page.
auth.validationPassword: Your password must be between 12 and 128 characters.
auth.validationInvalidCredentials: Enter your email address and password.
auth.errorInvalidCredentials: We could not sign you in with those details. Check them and try again.
auth.errorRateLimited: Too many attempts. Wait a moment before trying again.
auth.errorResetToken: This reset link is invalid or has expired. Request a new link to continue.

invitations.historyEmpty: Used, expired and revoked invitations will appear here.
invitations.copyError: Copying wasn’t available. Please try again.
